newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures close higher, led by September.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures close higher, led by September.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher, led by gains in the nearby September, before expiration of that contract slated for 1201 CDT Thursday, traders said.
Traders said a key commercial was getting out of its short positions in the September.
Short covering and a spate of PL480 business contributed to the advances, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, up from 295 Wednesday, according to the CBOT. Options volume was listed at 10 contracts, up from five Tuesday.
Rice futures closed 2-1/2 to 13 cents per cwt higher, with September up 13 at $10.27 per cwt.
